reserveReview.rationale: Midas identifies mMEV as a managed DeFi strategy NAV. The September 14 dashboard publishes rounded asset and protocol positions with material borrow offsets and a $100,000 main-position cutoff. The issuer-prepared September 8 weekly report covers mMEV and mROX jointly, with most assets grouped as Market Neutral Strategy. Neither source establishes a complete standalone mMEV reserve allocation; the joint pool must not be assigned in full to mMEV.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Midas mMEV product, risk, and transparency disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Complete signed positions, residuals, custody relationships and allocation of the jointly reported mMEV/mROX pool remain unverified. Published protocol exposures and aggregate joint assets do not resolve standalone mMEV backing weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Published protocol and asset positions provide candidate dependencies, but joint mMEV/mROX scope, borrowing and filtered positions require reconciliation before assigning reserve weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The dashboard names DeFi venues and signed positions, and the September 8 issuer report covers mMEV and mROX jointly. Complete wallet ownership, custody shares, reuse terms, legal segregation and token-specific allocation remain unverified. The joint report is issuer-prepared and does not provide independent custody assurance.
